competency.practice_task: Produce a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands grounded in a dated memory test with corrections.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report precision, temporal validity and abstention with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of memory evaluation.
Practice: the rerun agrees within a predeclared tolerance.
Measurement: report precision, temporal validity and abstention against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for grading against stale ground truth; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
